hypotheses.statement: A bold oversized headline over two smaller lighter lines creates a fast top-down hierarchy: name first, explanation second, offer last.
Extreme whitespace with text confined left and a single soft object isolated right creates a calm, airy, minimal mood that matches the product name.
A single small blue line at the bottom of a black-gray stack provides emphasis and action without breaking the monochrome calm.

relations.rule: Keep headline cap-height about 2x subcopy height with heavier weight and tighter spacing to preserve top-down hierarchy.
Keep text block confined to left half and a single product render isolated in the right third on a mostly empty field.
Restrict a single saturated accent hue to the bottom line only, covering under 5% of the frame.

fragile_if_changed: Replacing the vast empty white background with color, texture, or additional content would destroy the calm minimal contrast that defines the image.

skin_measured.how_measured: k-means (6 clusters) on the sent pixels for bg/fg; accent = median of strongly saturated mid-lightness pixels (s>0.45, 0.2<l<0.8) inside region 'blue accent line'
